def test_media_symlink_escape_after_session_creation_is_rejected(self, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
        inventory = _make_inventory(tmp_path, "synthetic_adj_symlink_escape")
        event = inventory["events"]["train_events/synthetic_adj_symlink_escape"]
        front = Path(event["raw_media"]["front"]["path"])
        session = create_session_from_inventory(
            inventory, "train_events/synthetic_adj_symlink_escape", SYNTHETIC_REVIEWER,
            SYNTHETIC_ALLOWLIST, output_dir=tmp_path / "output",
            time_source=_make_clock(), monotonic_source=_make_monotonic(),
        )
        # Point at an existing read-only system file outside tempfile storage;
        # the runner must reject its resolved path before reading it.
        outside_media = Path("/etc/hosts")
        front.unlink()
        front.symlink_to(outside_media)
        with pytest.raises(MediaHashMismatchError, match="Synthetic-only media path check"):
            session.start()
        assert not session.is_active
        front.unlink()

    """A denial raised by the operation-boundary guard must still be classified as a raw-media attempt."""

def test_agreement_between_training_and_inference_normalization():
    """Verify inference normalizer exactly matches the training-time feature transform formula."""
    raw_ckpt = torch.load(AUDIO_V3_CHECKPOINT, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
    train_norm_mean = float(raw_ckpt["norm_mean"])
    train_norm_std = float(raw_ckpt["norm_std"])

    classifier = PyTorchTrainHornClassifier(checkpoint_path=AUDIO_V3_CHECKPOINT)

    # Synthetic spectrogram
    np.random.seed(42)
    synthetic_spectrogram = np.random.uniform(-40.0, 20.0, size=(64, 61))

    # Training-time formula: (X - norm_mean) / norm_std
    expected_normalized = (synthetic_spectrogram - train_norm_mean) / train_norm_std

    # Inference-time formula: (log_mel - self.mean) / self.std
    actual_normalized = (synthetic_spectrogram - classifier.mean) / classifier.std

    np.testing.assert_allclose(actual_normalized, expected_normalized, rtol=1e-6, atol=1e-7)

    with open(V3_SELECTION) as f:

    test_recs = [r for r in records if r["partition"] == "test"]

    assert len(train_recs) == 120  # 60 pos + 60 neg
    assert len(val_recs) == 26    # 13 pos + 13 neg
    assert len(test_recs) == 26   # 13 pos + 13 neg

    # ESC-50 fold integrity
    for r in train_recs:
        if r["source_dataset"] == "ESC50":
            assert r["esc50_fold"] in [1, 2, 3], f"Unexpected fold in train: {r['esc50_fold']}"
    for r in val_recs:
        if r["source_dataset"] == "ESC50":

    for r in test_recs:
        if r["source_dataset"] == "ESC50":
            assert r["esc50_fold"] == 5, f"Unexpected fold in test: {r['esc50_fold']}"

    # Source group isolation

    val_sources = set(r["source_group"] for r in val_recs)

    assert len(train_sources & val_sources) == 0, "Source leakage Train & Val"
    assert len(train_sources & test_sources) == 0, "Source leakage Train & Test"

def test_execution_writes_exactly_28_notices_and_leaves_originals_untouched(repo: Path):
    _authorize(repo)
    originals = _originals(repo)
    assert len(originals) == 27
    before = _tree(repo)
    report = execute_leg_exec(repo, now=NOW)
    after = _tree(repo)

    assert report["completed"] is True and report["originals_byte_identical"] is True
    assert report["authorization_attestation"] == "recorded_statement_unsigned"
    assert report["ground_truth_created"] is False
    assert _originals(repo) == originals
    new = sorted(set(after) - set(before))
    assert len(new) == 28 == len(report["expected_output_inventory"])
    assert new == sorted(
        f"data/ground_truth/reviews/{n}" for n in report["expected_output_inventory"]
    )
    assert sum(1 for n in new if n.endswith(".INVALIDATION_NOTICE.json")) == 27
    assert any(n.endswith("_INTEGRITY_NOTICE.md") for n in new)
    # nothing else changed anywhere in the tree
    assert {k: v for k, v in after.items() if k in before} == before
    assert set(report["output_sha256"]) == set(report["expected_output_inventory"])
    assert report["source_record_sha256"] and len(report["source_record_sha256"]) == 27

def test_forged_or_edited_authorizations_never_execute(repo: Path, mutate, code):
    record = _authorize(repo)
    broken = json.loads(json.dumps(record))
    mutate(broken)
    path = repo / LEG_EXEC_AUTH_RELATIVE
    # Re-derive the self-hash for scope edits so only the scope check can catch them.
    if code == "LEG_EXEC_AUTH_SCOPE_MISMATCH":
        from railway_detection.annotation.leg_exec import _record_sha

        broken["record_sha256"] = _record_sha(broken)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(broken), encoding="utf-8")
    before = _tree(repo)
    with pytest.raises(LegExecError) as info:
        execute_leg_exec(repo, now=NOW)
    assert info.value.code == code
    assert _tree(repo) == before

def test_notice_verification_rejects_every_kind_of_inconsistency(repo: Path):
    _authorize(repo)
    execute_leg_exec(repo, now=NOW)
    reviews = repo / "data/ground_truth/reviews"
    notice = next(reviews.rglob("*.INVALIDATION_NOTICE.json"))
    record = notice.with_name(notice.name.replace(".INVALIDATION_NOTICE.json", ".json"))
    pristine = record.read_bytes()
    assert verify_invalidation_notice(notice, reviews).valid

    record.write_bytes(pristine + b"\n")  # record changed after the notice
    assert "changed after" in verify_invalidation_notice(notice, reviews).problem
    record.write_bytes(pristine)

    data = json.loads(notice.read_text())
    notice.write_text(json.dumps({**data, "disposition": "OK"}))
    assert not verify_invalidation_notice(notice, reviews).valid
    notice.write_text(json.dumps({**data, "applies_to_file": "somewhere/else_review.json"}))
    assert "does not name" in verify_invalidation_notice(notice, reviews).problem
    notice.write_text("{broken")
    assert "unreadable" in verify_invalidation_notice(notice, reviews).problem

        self, tmp_path: Path
    ) -> None:
        legacy_file = tmp_path / "train_events_event_001_camera_front_camera_1_vision.jsonl"
        legacy_file.write_text(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "timestamp_s": 0.0,
                    "source_id": "camera_1",
                    "modality": "vision",
                    "available": True,
                    "detections": [],
                    "metadata": {},
                }
            )
            + "\n",
            encoding="utf-8",
        )

        # Controlled loader rejects headerless historical file
        with pytest.raises(
            CacheProvenanceError, match="HISTORICAL_UNVERIFIED_CACHE_REJECTED"
        ):
            load_controlled_cache_jsonl(legacy_file, _make_provenance())

        # LayerBEventProcessor rejects headerless historical file by default
        proc = LayerBEventProcessor(cache_dir=tmp_path)
        fake_video = tmp_path / "train_events" / "event_001" / "camera_front.mov"
        with pytest.raises(
            CacheProvenanceError, match="HISTORICAL_UNVERIFIED_CACHE_REJECTED"
        ):
            proc.run_vision_inference(
                video_path=fake_video,
                checkpoint_path=Path("models/vision/best.pt"),
                source_id="camera_1",
                use_cache=True,
            )

        # Explicit historical diagnostic opt-in loads and marks records as historical_diagnostic
        hist_records = proc.run_vision_inference(
            video_path=fake_video,
            checkpoint_path=Path("models/vision/best.pt"),
            source_id="camera_1",
            use_cache=True,
            allow_historical_unverified_cache=True,
        )
        assert len(hist_records) == 1
        assert (
            hist_records[0].metadata["cache_classification"]
            == HISTORICAL_DIAGNOSTIC_CACHE_CLASS
        )
        assert hist_records[0].metadata["controlled_run_verified"] is False
        assert hist_records[0].metadata["official_evaluation_eligible"] is False

def test_layer_b_processor_build_stream_provenance_and_parameter_checks(
    tmp_path: Path,
) -> None:
    processor = LayerBEventProcessor(cache_dir=tmp_path)
    v_prov = processor.build_stream_provenance(
        cohort="train_events",
        event_id="event_001",
        source_id="camera_1",
        modality="vision",
        run_id="run_m3_01",
    )
    assert v_prov.model_architecture == processor.config.checkpoints.vision.model_name
    assert v_prov.preprocessing_config["image_size"] == [640, 640]
    assert v_prov.preprocessing_config["confidence_threshold_departure"] == 0.35

    a_prov = processor.build_stream_provenance(
        cohort="train_events",
        event_id="event_001",
        source_id="audio_1",
        modality="audio",
        run_id="run_m3_01",
    )
    assert a_prov.model_architecture == processor.config.checkpoints.audio_v3.model_name
    assert a_prov.preprocessing_config["n_mels"] == 64
    assert a_prov.preprocessing_config["n_fft"] == 512

    # Write controlled cache and load through run_vision_inference
    write_controlled_cache_jsonl(tmp_path, v_prov, _make_synthetic_records())
    loaded = processor.run_vision_inference(
        video_path=tmp_path / "train_events" / "event_001" / "camera_front.mov",
        checkpoint_path=tmp_path / "yolov8n.pt",
        source_id="camera_1",
        target_fps=v_prov.preprocessing_config["sampling_fps"],
        conf=v_prov.preprocessing_config["confidence_threshold_approach"],
        use_cache=True,
        provenance=v_prov,
    )
    assert len(loaded) == 2

    # Calling run_vision_inference with mismatched target_fps raises PROVENANCE_PREPROCESSING_MISMATCH
    with pytest.raises(CacheProvenanceError) as fps_exc:
        processor.run_vision_inference(
            video_path=tmp_path / "train_events" / "event_001" / "camera_front.mov",
            checkpoint_path=tmp_path / "yolov8n.pt",
            source_id="camera_1",
            target_fps=15.0,
            conf=0.35,
            use_cache=True,
            provenance=v_prov,
        )
    assert fps_exc.value.code == "PROVENANCE_PREPROCESSING_MISMATCH"

def test_repository_engine_event_scope_is_exactly_one_event() -> None:
    # 1. Inventory manifest
    inv_path = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "manifests" / "layer_b_v2_annotation_inventory.json"
    inv_data = json.loads(inv_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    cohorts: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
    for ev in inv_data.values():
        cohorts.setdefault(ev["category"], []).append(ev["event_id"])
    assert cohorts["engine_events"] == ["event_001"]
    assert sorted(cohorts["no_train_events"]) == ["event_001", "event_002", "event_003"]
    assert len(cohorts["train_events"]) == 23
    assert sum(len(v) for v in cohorts.values()) == 27

    # 2. Proposals directory (3 proposal versions v1..v3 all belong to event_001)
    proposals_dir = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "ground_truth" / "proposals"
    engine_proposals = sorted(p.name for p in (proposals_dir / "engine_events").glob("*.json"))
    assert engine_proposals == [
        "event_001_proposal_v1.json",
        "event_001_proposal_v2.json",
        "event_001_proposal_v3.json",
    ]
    assert all(name.startswith("event_001_") for name in engine_proposals)

    # 3. Reviews directory
    reviews_dir = REPO_ROOT / "data" / "ground_truth" / "reviews"
    engine_reviews = sorted(p.name for p in (reviews_dir / "engine_events").glob("*_review.json"))
    assert engine_reviews == ["event_001_review.json"]
    assert not (reviews_dir / "engine_events" / "event_002_review.json").exists()
    assert not (reviews_dir / "engine_events" / "event_003_review.json").exists()

    # 4. Stage-2.1 Review Queue
    queue_path = REPO_ROOT / "docs" / "generated" / "STAGE21_REVIEW_QUEUE.json"
    queue_data = json.loads(queue_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    assert queue_data["summary"]["total_events"] == 27
    engine_queue_items = [
        item for item in queue_data["items"] if item["cohort"] == "engine_events"
    ]
    notrain_queue_items = [
        item for item in queue_data["items"] if item["cohort"] == "no_train_events"
    ]
    train_queue_items = [
        item for item in queue_data["items"] if item["cohort"] == "train_events"
    ]
    assert len(engine_queue_items) == 1
    assert len(notrain_queue_items) == 3
    assert len(train_queue_items) == 23
    assert engine_queue_items[0]["event_key"] == "engine_events/event_001"

    )

        EvidenceRecord(
            timestamp_s=0.2,
            source_id="camera_1",

            available=True,
            detections=(
                Detection(
                    label="train",
                    confidence=0.91,
                    bbox_xyxy=(15.0, 25.0, 210.0, 310.0),
                ),
            ),
            metadata={"frame_index": 1},
        )
    ]
    cache_file = write_controlled_cache_jsonl(tmp_path, prov, records)

    # Loading with different run_id under default CACHE_REUSE_ISOLATED_RUN fails closed
    other_run_prov = processor.build_stream_provenance(
        cohort="train_events",
        event_id="event_001",
        source_id="camera_1",
        modality="vision",
        run_id="run_m4a_02",
    )
    with pytest.raises(CacheProvenanceError) as exc_info:
        load_controlled_cache_jsonl(
            cache_file, other_run_prov, reuse_policy=CACHE_REUSE_ISOLATED_RUN

    # Prohibited Audio V2 hash rejected when constructing provenance

        ControlledCacheProvenance(

            software_version="1.0.0-frozen",

    assert v2_exc.value.code == "PROHIBITED_CHECKPOINT_REJECTED"

        import hashlib

def test_active_cohort_event_and_stream_resolution():
    """Verify exact active cohort:

    - 23 train events
    - 3 no-train negative controls
    - 1 engine-only event
    - Total: 27 active events
    - Duplicate event_historical_duplicate_010 excluded
    - All 54 video streams resolvable and non-empty
    """
    v2_dir = Path("data/raw/layer_b/v2")
    assert v2_dir.is_dir(), "Missing data/raw/layer_b/v2 directory"

    cohorts = ["train_events", "no_train_events", "engine_events"]
    discovered_events: list[tuple[str, str, Path]] = []

    for cohort in cohorts:
        c_dir = v2_dir / cohort
        assert c_dir.is_dir(), f"Missing cohort directory: {c_dir}"
        for ed in sorted(c_dir.iterdir()):
            if not ed.is_dir() or not ed.name.startswith("event_"):
                continue
            if ed.name == "event_historical_duplicate_010":
                continue  # Properly excluded
            discovered_events.append((cohort, ed.name, ed))

    assert len(discovered_events) == 27, f"Expected 27 active events, found {len(discovered_events)}"

    train_evs = [e for e in discovered_events if e[0] == "train_events"]
    no_train_evs = [e for e in discovered_events if e[0] == "no_train_events"]
    engine_evs = [e for e in discovered_events if e[0] == "engine_events"]

    assert len(train_evs) == 23, f"Expected 23 train events, found {len(train_evs)}"
    assert len(no_train_evs) == 3, f"Expected 3 no-train events, found {len(no_train_evs)}"
    assert len(engine_evs) == 1, f"Expected 1 engine event, found {len(engine_evs)}"

    # Check that each event resolves both camera_front.mov and camera_back.mov
    stream_count = 0
    for cohort, name, ed in discovered_events:
        front = ed / "camera_front.mov"
        back = ed / "camera_back.mov"
        assert front.exists() and front.stat().st_size > 0, f"Invalid front camera in {ed}"
        assert back.exists() and back.stat().st_size > 0, f"Invalid back camera in {ed}"
        stream_count += 2

    assert stream_count == 54, f"Expected 54 active video streams, verified {stream_count}"

def test_synchronization_applied_exactly_once(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    """A back-camera record at local t=10.0, under a validated offset of
    +7.406s, must appear in the produced frames at master time 17.406 --
    not 10.0 (offset not applied) and not 24.812 (offset applied twice)."""
    back_offset_s = 7.406
    manifest_path = _write_synthetic_manifest(tmp_path, back_offset_s)
    validated = load_validated_sync_aligner(
        manifest_path, "train_events/event_900", repo_root=tmp_path, allow_candidate_status=True
    )

    processor = _processor(tmp_path)
    front_recs = _front_records(n=20, hop_s=1.0)  # local t = 0..19
    back_recs = _back_records(n=20, hop_s=1.0, start_local_s=0.0)  # local t = 0..19

    frames = processor.build_multimodal_frames(
        vision_records=front_recs + back_recs,
        audio_records=[],
        duration_s=30.0,
        stride_s=0.2,
        sync_aligner=validated.aligner,
    )

    # The collector's frame window looks BACKWARD from each frame's own
    # master_timestamp_s (window = [t - window_tolerance_s, t]), so a record
    # at master time M first becomes visible in frames whose own
    # master_timestamp_s lies in [M, M + window_tolerance_s]. Scan every
    # frame for the back-camera's local-t=10.0 record and check which
    # master times it was actually observed at, rather than guessing a
    # single frame index.
    target_master_t = 10.0 + back_offset_s  # expected: applied exactly once
    doubled_master_t = 10.0 + 2 * back_offset_s  # must NOT appear here

    observed_master_times = [
        f.master_timestamp_s
        for f in frames
        for r in f.vision_records
        if r.source_id == "camera_2" and abs(r.timestamp_s - 10.0) < 1e-6
    ]
    assert observed_master_times, "back-camera local t=10.0 record was never observed in any frame"
    assert all(
        target_master_t <= m <= target_master_t + 0.3 for m in observed_master_times
    ), (
        f"back-camera local t=10.0 must surface only within "
        f"[{target_master_t}, {target_master_t + 0.3}] (offset applied exactly once); "
        f"observed at {observed_master_times}"
    )
    assert not any(doubled_master_t - 0.3 <= m <= doubled_master_t + 0.3 for m in observed_master_times), (
        f"offset must not be applied twice (would surface near master_t={doubled_master_t})"
    )

    # The front camera (offset 0.0) must still appear at its own local time.
    front_at_10 = [f for f in frames if abs(f.master_timestamp_s - 10.0) < 0.15]
    assert any(
        r.source_id == "camera_1" and abs(r.timestamp_s - 10.0) < 1e-6
        for f in front_at_10
        for r in f.vision_records
    )

def test_r04_inventory_is_event_level_and_fail_closed() -> None:
    evidence = build_r04_evidence(ROOT)
    assert evidence["status"] == "CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_ONLY_NO_AUTOMATIC_APPROVAL"
    assert evidence["summary"]["total_events"] == 27
    assert evidence["summary"]["dual_camera_candidate_count"] == 12
    assert evidence["summary"]["premature_opening_candidate_coverage"]["v9"][
        "candidate_boundary_coverage_count"
    ] == 11
    assert evidence["summary"]["premature_opening_candidate_coverage"]["v9"][
        "official_evaluable_count"
    ] == 0
    assert evidence["summary"]["premature_opening_candidate_coverage"]["m4"][
        "official_evaluable_count"
    ] == 0
    assert evidence["summary"]["verdict_counts"] == {
        "AMBIGUOUS": 8,
        "CALIBRATION_SUPPORTED": 12,
        "PROVISIONAL": 7,
    }
    assert evidence["calibration_manifest_status"] == "CANDIDATE_UNVALIDATED_DO_NOT_MERGE"
    assert evidence["human_review_status"].startswith("REVIEWED_WITH_CORROBORATION")
    by_key = {row["event_key"]: row for row in evidence["events"]}
    assert by_key["train_events/event_010"]["calibration"]["verdict"] == "CALIBRATION_SUPPORTED"
    assert by_key["engine_events/event_001"]["candidate_proposal"]["version"] == 3
    assert by_key["engine_events/event_001"]["candidate_proposal"]["matches_snapshot"] is False
    assert (
        by_key["engine_events/event_001"]["candidate_proposal"]["snapshot_sha256"]
        is not None
    )
    assert evidence["candidate_proposal_selection"].startswith("highest numeric")
    # A supported calibration does not make an event evaluable when T4 is
    # missing; boundary eligibility and clock eligibility are separate gates.
    assert by_key["train_events/event_005"]["calibration"]["verdict"] == "CALIBRATION_SUPPORTED"
    assert by_key["train_events/event_005"]["boundaries"]["T4_tail_clearance"]["value_s"] is None
    assert (
        by_key["train_events/event_005"]["metric_boundary_compatibility"]["v9"][
            "candidate_evaluable"
        ]
        is False
    )
    assert (
        by_key["train_events/event_001"]["clock_scope"]["scope_status"]
        == "EXPLORATORY_CANDIDATE_ONLY"
    )
    assert (
        by_key["train_events/event_001"]["clock_scope"]["scope_decision_status"]
        == "RESEARCHER_DECISION_REQUIRED"
    )
    assert by_key["train_events/event_001"]["metric_boundary_compatibility"]["m4"][
        "candidate_evaluable"
    ] is False
    assert evidence["decision_required"]["status"] == "MISSING_RESEARCHER_DECISION"

    """Validate the active Layer B V2 video manifest schema, counts, and media attributes."""
    assert V2_VIDEO_MANIFEST_PATH.exists(), "real_world_v2_video_manifest.json must exist"

        manifest = json.load(f)

    assert manifest["version"] == "2.0.0"
    assert manifest["total_records"] == 56

    summary = manifest["summary"]
    assert summary["train_events"] == 23
    assert summary["engine_events_eligible"] == 1
    assert summary["engine_events_historical_duplicate"] == 1
    assert summary["no_train_events"] == 3
    assert summary["total_video_files"] == 56

    records = manifest["records"]
    assert len(records) == 56

    front_records = [r for r in records if r["camera_id"] == "front"]
    back_records = [r for r in records if r["camera_id"] == "back"]
    assert len(front_records) == 28
    assert len(back_records) == 28

    eligible_records = [r for r in records if r["evaluation_eligible"] is True]
    assert len(eligible_records) == 54  # 27 active evaluation events * 2 cameras

    duplicate_records = [r for r in records if r["evaluation_eligible"] is False]
    assert len(duplicate_records) == 2
    for r in duplicate_records:
        assert r["event_id"] == "event_historical_duplicate_010"

    for r in records:
        assert r["has_audio"] is True
        assert r["audio_codec"] == "aac"
        assert r["audio_sample_rate"] == 48000
        assert r["codec"] in ("hevc", "h264")

        dst_path = WORKSPACE_ROOT / r["destination_path"]
        assert dst_path.exists(), f"Destination video {dst_path} does not exist"

    # Verify historical V1 retirement is documented
